lines.beaver: 이 사진에 사람이 정말 많네요. 누구예요?
lines.beaver_en: There are so many people in this photo. Who are they?
lines.beaver_roman: I sajine sarami jeongmal manneyo. Nuguyeyo?
lines.en: They're my family. It's a holiday photo, you see.

lines.beaver_en: Does everyone get together on holidays?
lines.learner: 네, 큰아버지 댁에 다 모여요. 집이 크거든요.
lines.en: Yes, we all gather at my uncle's. His house is big.
lines.roman: Ne, keunabeoji daege da moyeoyo. Jibi keugeodeunyo.

lines.beaver_en: Who is the person next to your uncle?
lines.en: That's my aunt. She's a really good cook.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have a lot of cousins too?
lines.learner: 네, 사촌이 여섯 명이에요. 저 둘은 쌍둥이예요.
lines.en: Yes, I have six cousins. Those two are twins.
lines.roman: Ne, sachoni yeoseon myeongieyo. Jeo dureun ssangdungiyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, they look exactly alike! Can you tell them apart?
lines.learner: 아니요, 아무도 구별 못 해요. 저도요.
lines.en: No, nobody can tell them apart. Not even me.
lines.roman: Aniyo, amudo gubyeol mot haeyo. Jeodoyo.

lines.learner: 막내 사촌이에요. 엄마 품에 안겨 있어요.
lines.en: That's my youngest cousin. She's being held in her mom's arms.
lines.roman: Mangnae sachonieyo. Eomma pume angyeo isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Are the two people sitting in front your parents?
lines.en: Yes, they're my parents. My mom is my stepmother.

lines.beaver_en: How do you get along with your stepmother?
lines.learner: 아주 좋아요. 저한테 정말 잘해 주세요.
lines.en: Really well. She's really good to me.
lines.roman: Aju joayo. Jeohante jeongmal jalhae juseyo.

lines.learner: 네, 우리는 세 자매예요. 제가 막내예요.
lines.en: Yes, we're three sisters. I'm the youngest.
lines.roman: Ne, urineun se jamaeyeyo. Jega mangnaeyeyo.
